item.title: CNMI DOL: Employers must give advance notice of layoffs, closures
item.description: (CNMI DOL) — The CNMI Department of Labor is reminding all employers that timely communication with the Department and affected employees is required in the event of a reduction in force or business closure, as outlined in § 80-20.1-240 of the CNMI Administrative Code.
